MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

2. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   B. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

5. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
